description: Decorative artwork whose hairlines the opening removed, 3.1 % of its area (the example of docs/plan/02), above maxRemovedAreaPct 1 %: warning.

findings.fix: if the red regions matter, make those lines wider than 0.8 mm or the artwork larger, until the opening removes at most 1 % (the rule reports more than maxRemovedAreaPct); otherwise you may export as it is
findings.message: the morphological opening removed 3.1 % of the artwork area, more than the 1 % allowed (maxRemovedAreaPct of process `fdm-0.4`): strokes thinner than the 0.8 mm minimum feature do not print, and the removed regions are shown in red in the preview
